name: Campus Placement Aptitude Practice Mock - Practice Test 1

questions.question: If the cost price of an item is Rs 200 and it is sold for Rs 250, what is the profit percentage?
A train running at 54 km/hr crosses a post in 10 seconds. What is the length of the train?
Find the odd one out: Apple, Orange, Potato, Banana
questions.hint: Potato is a tuber root vegetable; the rest are sweet fruits.

questions.question: If in a code language, CAT is written as DBT, then DOG is written as:
questions.hint: C+1=D, A+1=B, T+0=T. So D+1=E, O+1=P, G+0=G. Wait, let's look at DOG. D+1=E, O+1=P, G+0=G, which is EPG. Wait, options has EPH. If the rule is C+1=D, A+1=B, T+0=T, then D+1=E, O+1=P, G+1=H -> EPH. Yes!

questions.question: A work is completed by 5 men in 10 days. How many days will 10 men take to complete the same work?
What is the average of first five prime numbers?
In OOPS, wrapping data and methods into a single unit is called:
questions.hint: Encapsulation restricts direct access and bundles code blocks together.

questions.question: Which language is purely object-oriented among these?
questions.hint: Java requires classes for all methods, aligning with object models.

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 20 and their difference is 4. Find the product of the two numbers.
Which data structure operates on FIFO?
questions.hint: Queues process items in order of arrival (First-In First-Out).

questions.question: If A is B's brother, and B is C's sister, how is A related to C?
questions.hint: Since A and B are siblings, and B and C are siblings, A is C's brother.

questions.question: A man walks 5 km South, then turns East and walks 3 km, then turns North and walks 5 km. How far is he from starting point?
questions.hint: He forms a rectangle, ending up exactly 3 km East of origin.

questions.question: The probability of rolling a 4 on a fair six-sided die is:
questions.hint: There is 1 favorable outcome out of 6 possible values.
